author: Sarah M.
text: Ordered at lunch, it arrived in under an hour. The Miami Mint is sweet but not heavy — lasted me the full week. Packaging was sealed and authentic.

author: Jake T.
text: Great value for 10,000 puffs. Watermelon Ice is my go-to now — smooth throat hit and the battery level display is actually accurate. Shipped the same day via Australia Post.

author: Emma L.
productName: Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 Blue Razz Ice
text: 25,000 puffs feels like it lasts forever. Blue Razz Ice tastes exactly like the packet says. I checked the scratch code against Geek Bar's site and it's genuine.

author: Liam W.
text: Reliable every time — I've ordered the IGET Bar four times now and it's always consistent. Delivery to Perth took three days with tracking the whole way.

author: Mia R.
text: The Ingot 15000 Mango is my favourite — flavour doesn't fade even towards the end of the device. Quick chat on Telegram confirmed my order before it shipped.

author: Oliver B.
productName: Geek Bar Meloso Mini Blueberry Ice
text: Perfect compact size for carrying in the car. Blueberry Ice is clean and refreshing. Charged it with my USB-C once and it topped right up.

author: Chloe H.
text: The courier brought it to my apartment in Parramatta within the two-hour window. Mango Magic is super smooth, and the 22mL tank genuinely lasted the full 10k puffs.

author: Ethan K.
text: Great flavour and price. The USB-C charging is handy. Only note — a few flavours sell out quickly, but they restocked within the week.

author: Isla F.
text: First order with Vape Spot and I'm impressed. Bit of a sour kick on the lemonade that keeps it interesting. Genuine stock with the authenticity sticker intact.

author: Noah D.
productName: Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 Cool Mint
text: Bought two Pulse X 25k in Cool Mint for the month and saved on shipping. Support answered my ID question on Telegram in minutes. Solid, trustworthy store.
